description: This file declares exported API functions related to HTTP MBO File objects within a BroadWay service framework. It includes function prototypes for creating, removing, enrolling, and initializing MBO File objects in a platform-independent HTTP implementation.

methods.name: HttpCreateMboFile
methods.description: Creates a new MBO File object with specified context handles.

methods.name: HttpMboFileCreate
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new Http Mbo File object.

methods.name: HttpMboFileRemove
methods.description: Removes and cleans up the specified Http Mbo File object.

methods.name: HttpMboFileEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls or registers required objects within the Http Mbo File object context.

methods.name: HttpMboFileInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the Http Mbo File object after creation.
